usa.name: North America
usa.insight: Largest AI testing market globally — leads in GenAI QA adoption and investment.

canada.name: Canada
canada.insight: Strong AI talent pipeline; Toronto & Vancouver emerging as AI testing hubs.

uk.name: United Kingdom
uk.insight: Europe's top AI investor — government-backed National AI Strategy drives QA adoption.

europe.name: Western Europe
europe.insight: GDPR-compliant AI testing frameworks lead globally. Germany & France at the forefront.

poland.name: Poland
poland.insight: Fastest-growing QA outsourcing destination in the EU — strong STEM talent base.

india.name: India
india.insight: World's largest QA outsourcing market — AI-powered test generation leads APAC.

china.name: East Asia
china.insight: Rapid domestic AI testing tooling growth; ByteDance & Alibaba invest heavily in QA AI.

japan.name: Japan
japan.insight: Precision manufacturing culture drives strict QA standards — AI adoption accelerating.

australia.name: Australia / NZ
australia.insight: Strong fintech & healthtech sectors drive AI QA growth — government AI ethics push.

brazil.name: Brazil
brazil.insight: São Paulo becomes LATAM's AI hub — fintech testing drives 60% of regional growth.

uae.name: Middle East
uae.insight: UAE Vision 2031 commits $2B+ to AI — Dubai positions as global AI testing sandbox.
